svg.title: Vectorlab
svg.desc: Vectorlab banner: two clusters of activation points in a 3D space above a floor grid, the arrow r from the mean of one class to the other, and an animation that removes each point's component along r so both classes land on the plane perpendicular to r. The title Vectorlab is drawn with arrows.
